book.name: WALOMA
book.title: LUPWILILI LWANDIKIGWE NA MTUMIGWA WA KILISTO PAULO HA WALOMA

content: Muyahudi kana kinhu chaki kibanzile? Ama kuna kinhu chaki cha kuigodela mwa munhu yengizigwe kumbi?
Kuna vinhu bwando va kuigodela! Tanhu, Mulungu kawagwelela Wayahudi usenga wake.
Yowaze kamba wayagwe mmwanza wao wabule nhamanila? Kuwa bule nhamanila kuwali nako komtenda Mulungu yawe kizenzeleganye?
Bule! Hata kamba kila munhu yahawa m'vwizi, Mulungu havwiza. Kamba Nyandiko Zing'alile vuzilonga,

content.text: “Giladi upetigwe kamba kwabule uzenzeleganye mzimbuli zako,

content: Kamba mbuli zetu zihile zosimulila lumosilumosi vija Mulungu viyalibule uzenzeleganye, tulongeze? Tulonge Mulungu kotenda vihile voyotugalila tweye lusango lwake? Hano nolonga kiunhu.
Bule! Ihawile hivo, Mulungu yahadahile vilihi kuutagusa ulumwengu?
Ila ihawa uvwizi wangu woisang'hanikila yenzi ya Mulungu mkuitenda ikweli yake itangigwe ng'hani, habali ning'hali nidukumizwa kamba mtenda vilozo?
Habali hatulonga, kamba wanhu wayagwe vowotulonga vihile mkutulonga kamba tweye tulonga, “Leka tutende gehile giladi geze ganogile”? Walumba kutagusigwa.
Haduhu Munhu Yalibule Uzenzeleganye
Avo tulongeze? Tweye Wayahudi tunoga kubanza wanhu wayagwe? Bule! Kwavija tweye tose twisha kutagusigwa, wose, Wayahudi na Wamhazi twa hasi ya mhiko za vilozo.
Kamba Nyandiko Zing'alile vuzilonga,

content.text: “Haduhu munhu yalibule uzenzeleganye, haduhu hata munhu imwe,
haduhu munhu yotenda ganogile, haduhu hata munhu imwe.
Mikolomelo yao ya kamba panga digubuligwe,
sumu ya nyoka ya mmilomo yao.
Milomo yao imema ndukumiza na usungu.
Magulu gao gowalongoza walopole kwita mulopa,
ubananzi na migayo va mzinzila zao,
Haduhu bwembwe da Mulungu haulongozi wa meso gao.”

content: Sambi tovitanga kamba Malagizo ga Musa gowalonga waja wali hasi ya Gamalagizo higo, giladi munhu yoyose sambiyawe na mbuli ya kuigombela, na ulumwengu wose ulamulwe na Mulungu.
Kwavija haduhu munhu yondayapetigwe kamba kabule uzenzeleganye hameso gake mkugagoga Malagizo, kwavija kubitila Malagizo higo topata udaho wa kuvitanga vilozo tu.
Vija Mulungu Viyotutenda Tuwe Bule Uzenzeleganye
Ila sambi nzila ya Mulungu ya kuwatenda wanhu wawe bule uzenzeleganye igubuligwa bila kutamanila Malagizo ga Musa, hata kamba Malagizo ga Musa na Nyandiko Zing'alile za wahokozi woilavila usindila.
Kuwa bule uzenzeleganye kokwiza kubitila kumtamanila Yesu Kilisto
mwa awo wose wotogola. Haduhu yam'banzile miyage,
kwavija wose watenda vilozo na kuhungukilwa na yenzi ya Mulungu.
Wapetigwa kuwa wanhu walibule uzenzeleganye bila kuliha kinhu chochose, kubitila ukombola kulawa ha Yesu Kilisto.

Mulungu kamulava Yesu yawe kamba nhosa ya kuwalumba wanhu na heyo mwenyego kubitila nhamanila mmulopa wake. Kagatenda gano kulagusa kamba kabule uzenzeleganye, kwavija mkwazaganya kumwake Mulungu hawataguse awo watendile vilozo umwaka.
Kagatenda gano giladi yalaguse kamba kabule uzenzeleganye mkipigiti kino na kamba voyomtenda munhu yoyose yomtamanila Yesu yawe bule uzenzeleganye.
Avo, choni chondatuigodele? Hahudu! Tuigode kwavija tugagoga Malagizo ga Musa? Si vivo, ila kwavija tutogola kamba Yesu kotukombola.
Kwavija tuvimanya kamba munhu kopetigwa kamba kabule uzenzeleganye kubitila nhamanila na sio mkugagoga Gamalagizo ga Musa.
Ama Mulungu ka Mulungu wa Wayahudi weiyeka? Heyo vivija hali Mulungu wa Wamhazi? Ona, heyo vivija ka Mulungu wa Wamhazi.
Mulungu ka imwe, yowatenda wawe bule uzenzeleganye waja wengile kumbi kubitila nhamanila na waja walekile kwingila kumbi kubitila nhamanila iija.
Avo, tugase Gamalagizo ga Musa sama ya nhamanila ino? Si vivo, ila togavikiza Gamalagizo ga Musa.
